messages.en:
Mrmh.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{07 12 00} Would you just shut
up!{01 00 00 14 00} Yap yap yap! That's all
you do! {01 00 00 14 00}I just got up, OK?
{07 0b 00}What?{01 00 00 14 00} Oh, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}, it's
you. Why are you here,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 1b 00}Do me a favor and wait
outside {01 00 00 05 00}at least until I've 
brushed my teeth.
messages.et:
Mrmh.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{07 12 00} Jää ometi vait!
{01 00 00 14 00}Läks-läks-läks! Muud sa
ei teegi! {01 00 00 14 00}Ma just ärkasin!
{07 0b 00}Mida?{01 00 00 14 00} Oh, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}, sina.
Mida sa siin teed,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 1b 00}Tee mulle teene ja oota
väljas, {01 00 00 05 00}kuni olen 
hambad pesnud.

messages.en:
{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Oh, hey{01 07 00}!{01 00 00 0f 00}
{07 1b 00}You're like a dog, all hyper
for your morning walk!
Listen up! I don't have
anything for you! Got that,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?!
messages.et:
{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Oh, hei{01 07 00}!{01 00 00 0f 00}
{07 1b 00}Sa oled nagu koer, kes
ootab hommikust käiku!
Kuula! Mul pole sulle
midagi! Said aru,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?!

messages.en:
{07 15 00}Hey, hey!{01 00 00 05 00} Listen up,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 01 00}You don't go into a home{01 00 00 05 00}
AND YELL AT THE TOP OF YOUR
LUNGS!{01 00 00 14 00} I CAN HEAR YOU!

{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Hello there{01 07 00}!{01 00 00 05 00}
It's you, huh, {01 00 00 05 00}{0b 03 00}{04 02 00}!
The night's still young.
{07 0d 00}Why don't you and I do
something FUN tonight{01 00 00 0a 00} for
a change!

Oh, {01 00 00 0f 00}{04 1f 00}, it's just
you!

{07 1b 00}You're like some lost puppy
wandering into someone's
house at this hour!
messages.et:
Oh, {01 00 00 0f 00}{04 1f 00}, see oled
lihtsalt sina!

{07 1b 00}Oled nagu eksinud kutsikas,
kes uitab sel kellaajal
kellegi majja!

messages.en:
What do you want?!{01 00 00 14 00}
{07 0b 00}Are you sleepwalking or
something?!
{07 15 00}Wake up! {01 00 00 05 00}Wake up! {01 00 00 05 00}WAKE UP!
You're in my house,
{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
Mida sa tahad?!{01 00 00 14 00}
{07 0b 00}Kas sa kõnnid unes või
midagi?!
{07 15 00}Ärka! {01 00 00 05 00}Ärka! {01 00 00 05 00}ÄRKA ÜLES!
Sa oled minu majas,
{04 02 00}!
